name: io.github.kKEo/memory-find
description: Local, explainable knowledge base for agents: hybrid search with provenance, trust and time, in one Go binary over SQLite.

environmentVariables.name: MEMO_KB
environmentVariables.description: Name of the knowledge base to open; one SQLite file per name under $MEMO_HOME/kb/.

environmentVariables.name: MEMO_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Base directory for knowledge bases and settings (default ~/.memo-mcp).

environmentVariables.name: MEMO_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Embedding model id from `memo-mcp model ls` (default granite-small-r2).
